scope: H8 original span15 seeds0,1; shifted span11 seeds0,1,2; all existing checkpoints0..40000; CPU float64, no training
input_ensemble: All3481 ordered input pairs, equally weighted. Construct token/role arrays directly. Never construct or load target labels or data split in observable calculation. The ensemble includes held-out inputs, so this is label-free, not held-out-input-free.
states: 64-dimensional primary states immediately after each block LayerNorm, before final query-only LayerNorm and classifier
writeback: Second block at actual query; each mode bilinear contribution after gate,beta and shared out.weight; exclude out.bias; total=sum(mode writes)
G: Mean-centered across the fixed input ensemble, normalized inner product; G0q and G0b for both layers, q=15,b=7 or q=11,b=5
response: Exact64x64 d h2_query / d embedded_h0_site0, other embedded sites held fixed. Full LayerNorm derivatives. Report mean and RMS Frobenius norm across all3481 inputs; primary curve=mean.
spectra: Eigenvalues of centered query writeback covariance / trace. S=-sum p ln(p), natural logarithms. D=1/sum p^2. Total primary, mode3/mode4 retained as supplementary.
q34: Centered normalized inner product of actual mode3/mode4 query writes across inputs; undefined for zero variance
time_alignment: Absolute training step. Original every1000; shifted every500; no estimated or missing checkpoints filled in.
outcome_metadata: Read previous frozen roster, labels refer to100k outcomes only and never enter extraction functions. Shifted seed0 reaches90 with a broad transition; not a failure control.

separation_rule.report: First episode lasting5000steps; also first episode lasting all the way to40k. Evaluate at actual common1000-step checkpoints. Thresholds descriptive, not a significance test or calibrated warning rule.

statistical_limits: One success and one failure do not estimate seed-level significance or warning reliability. Timepoints are not independent replicate runs. Spectrum decrease, response peak or positive overlap need not accompany ordering.
duplicates_audit: Existing source records residue Fourier entropy and residue effective dimension, plus label-dependent field and deletion diagnostics. Those are different from writeback-covariance spectra and exact hidden-state input response here. Reuse propagation and writeback formulas.
